steps.caption: Agency workspace
steps.narration: On the Agency plan, the Agency workspace runs one action across many client locations.

steps.caption: Tick boxes
steps.narration: Every location in the list has a tick box.

steps.caption: Tick another
steps.narration: Tick as many as you need.

steps.caption: Apply to selected locations
steps.narration: Apply to selected locations appears under the list.

steps.caption: The actions
steps.narration: Sync now, Link & sync, Unlink, Assign client, Set Watch mode, or a post batch.

steps.caption: Set Watch mode
steps.narration: Set Watch mode picks Off, Notify or Lockdown for every ticked listing.

steps.selector: p:has-text("Enabling requires a previously approved snapshot")
steps.caption: Needs an approved snapshot
steps.narration: It needs an approved snapshot on each location first; the others fail safely.

steps.caption: Assign client
steps.narration: Assign client moves the ticked listings into a client workspace.

steps.caption: Queue selected action
steps.narration: Queue selected action sends them to the job queue.

steps.caption: Queued
steps.narration: Two location actions queued. Jobs shows their progress and any failures.

steps.caption: Jobs
steps.narration: Jobs lists each one with its status.

steps.caption: Menu: Agency
steps.narration: You'll find Agency in the Google Business menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to run bulk actions across client locations | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: The Agency workspace in ConstructHUB on the Agency plan: tick client locations, pick one action for all of them, and queue it. Sync now, Link & sync, Unlink, Assign client, Set Watch mode, AI reply settings or a post batch. Jobs lists every queued action with its progress and failures.
